tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results distinguish files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Use exclude patterns to skip node_modules.
